title: Claims rules — Life Insurance Code of Practice and income protection benefits
product: Life Insurance Code of Practice (CALI, 2025 edition) and APRA's individual disability income insurance measures
version: Rule guide FY2026-27 v1.0 — current at 23 Nov 2026 (Life Code effective 1 Mar 2025)
summary: The standards insurers that subscribe to the Life Insurance Code of Practice must meet when they handle claims, how income protection benefits are worked out under APRA's measures, and how Life Advice Guru uses both to support clients and families through a claim. The Code binds insurers, not advisers: Ben's Claims Agent tracks each insurer against it and keeps the client informed.
limits: The insurer decides every claim; Life Advice Guru's agents never accept, decline or promise an outcome, and never lodge a claim without human approval. The Code binds insurers, not Life Advice Guru. Income protection can't be agreed value, and benefits under policies issued from 1 Oct 2021 follow earnings at the time of the claim, so they can be less than the insured benefit. The Code review's proposals and APRA's suspended contract-term measure must not be presented as current rules.
evidenceRequired: Claim form and the claimant's certified ID
Medical evidence that meets the policy definition (e.g. a specialist's report; histopathology for a cancer claim)
Income protection: earnings evidence for the 12 months before the disability
Death: certified copy of the death certificate and proof of entitlement (nominated beneficiary or estate)
Bank account in the payee's own name
